description: This file contains integration tests (IT) for the SearchActor in the org.eclipse.ditto.services.thingsearch.starter.actors package. It verifies search functionalities such as search results, streaming, and cursor-based pagination, by setting up MongoDB resources, creating test cases, and interacting with Akka actors.

classes.name: SearchActorIT
classes.description: Integration test class for SearchActor, testing search, streaming, and cursor-based search functionalities using real MongoDB instances and Akka actors.

methods.name: startMongoResource
methods.description: Initializes MongoDB resource and query parser before all tests.

methods.name: before
methods.description: Sets up the actor system, persistence layers, and MongoDB collection before each test.

methods.name: provideReadPersistence
methods.description: Creates and initializes MongoDB search persistence.

methods.name: provideWritePersistence
methods.description: Provides a test stream for search update streaming.

methods.name: provideClientWrapper
methods.description: Creates MongoDB client wrapper pointing to the test database.

methods.name: after
methods.description: Cleans up MongoDB collection and shuts down actor system after each test.

methods.name: stopMongoResource
methods.description: Stops MongoDB resource and closes connections after all tests.

methods.name: testSearch
methods.description: Tests search functionality returning expected result IDs.

methods.name: testStream
methods.description: Tests streaming search results through Akka SourceRef.

methods.name: testCursorSearch
methods.description: Tests paginated cursor-based search over multiple queries.

methods.name: queryThings
methods.description: Constructs search query commands with optional size and cursor for pagination.

methods.name: insertTestThings
methods.description: Inserts test things into MongoDB for search tests.

methods.name: expectedIds
methods.description: Generates expected result array of Thing IDs based on input ordinals.

methods.name: wrapAsSearchResult
methods.description: Wraps a Thing ID into a JSON object for search result.

methods.name: template
methods.description: Creates a test Thing object with specific attributes for insertion.
